subject: Fix GCC 12 build and 'local' outside function in CI script (#1520)
reason: The change is a build/CI fix with no behaviour change: the CI script edit removes an invalid 'local' outside a function in ci/clang-format-tidy.sh (lint tooling only), and the src/index_schema.cc edit swaps std::format for absl::StrFormat in an error-message string to fix GCC 12 compilation, producing an identical message on a rarely reachable internal-error path during RDB load. No command reply, persistence, replication or stability behaviour differs between the builds, so a compared scenario could never show a difference.
